question: Same FQN and method name in two projects: which target is called?
required_facts: Shop.Orders.OrderService exists in ProjectA and ProjectB as separate assemblies.
A call resolved in ProjectA must cite ProjectA/Orders/OrderService.cs and must not merge with ProjectB.
The two Update methods have different bodies and must not be treated as one partial entity.
forbidden_claims: resolving ProjectA.Update to ProjectB by nearest filename or same FQN
claiming a single deployed assembly without scope evidence
